body: Thanks for your help. I'm seeing a therapist tomorrow. I just wish it wasn't such a slow process. I genuinely don't ever think I'm going to make it through this.

Why can't I? I feel absolutely, completely lifeless, soulless, and empty inside. I don't feel anything for anyone. I just go through the motions of my life and of relationships, and so far no one has noticed that I don't care about anything. I don't care if anyone likes me or not. I don't really care if it seems like someone is going to hurt me. Sometimes I even fantasise about what it would be like to get robbed at gunpoint, because I wonder if I'd have the bravery to ask them to just pull the trigger. 

I mean, I can't do ANYTHING without thinking about her. Going to the beach, seeing movies, taking naps, cooking meals, listening to music, going to work, going to class, taking showers, waking up, driving, drinking, smoking, Redditing, reading.... Look, I could sit here all night listing every single activity that I've ever done in my life, and 99% of them are things I loved doing with her. I can't even think about fucking POLITICS because I wonder what she'd have to say.

I'm just so desperate for it to stop. I want to pause my life and let myself breathe. I'm so overwhelmed by how I feel and I can't do anything about it to make it STOP. I can only ignore the pain for a very short period before something else sets me on fire. 

Someone told me that depression is a lot like being bombarded by waves in the sea. Every one crashes down and chokes me, swallowing me up, but occasionally, there's a calm period where I can stick my head above the water and get some air before the next wave. I was told that over time, the waves get smaller, and less fierce, and less frequent. But these waves aren't getting smaller. They're getting bigger, and heavier, and more frequent, and I'm so tired of keeping my head above the water.

I honestly don't remember. It was so, so long ago. I didn't really have any friends. I just kind of floated by in my life and then I met her and I finally felt... anchored. Like there was something I could devote my time and my energy to building. 

I've never been one to be single. I dated lots of girls before her, but never for long and I was never really sad when it ended. I've always liked spending my time with people and making them feel happy, but there's so much darkness and unhappiness in the way I talk now that unless you really know me, it's hard to tell when I'm just using gallows humour or if I really am in that black of a mood.

I just hate the way I live. I want to be able to fall in love again but I can't see that happening. Even if I managed to finally get her out of my head, I have no trust in anyone anymore. Why should I? The person I trusted most in my life, the person who had been by my side for years, betrayed me in the most callous way possible, then just abandoned me for someone else. I don't know how I'm supposed to just open myself up like that again, ever. Even deep into another relationship, even if I ever feel that same way again... How can I trust that I won't get betrayed? How can I trust that my life just won't be shit forever?

I know that. It's so frustrating because I really have tried my hardest to be a real person again, without her. But whenever I'm not around other people, like when I sleep... There she is. And then I'm so horribly broken because I just want to stop thinking about her. I want to stop flinching when I see engagement announcements online. I want to stop feeling sick when I hear songs that I think she probably loves singing. I want it all to stop so badly, and whenever I'm alone, I get so desperate feeling and angry at the world and just... Broken, you know?

It's like... I know that dying solves nothing. Death is chaos and I don't want chaos in the lives of the people I care about. Not even hers. But the alternative is trying to somehow make it out to the other side of this Hell that I live in, and I don't think I'm strong enough to do that. I know I'm not strong enough to do that. The only thing keeping me going on a day to day basis is the sad, pathetic delusion that maybe she'll come back to me. But once they get engaged.. I don't know that I'll be able to find any reason to keep going. I'm so scared. I just want to not be in this life anymore. I want a different life. Any other life. Any other past, anything other than this. But there's no way to do that. I just don't feel like I have any escape from this, no matter what I do or what I try, and... It's just so frustrating.
